brief.headline: NVDA leads $17.9B outflow; semis split as AMD surges 5.3% on $9.5B inflow.
tldr: NVDA bled $17.9B, its 5th straight outflow day, down 2.9%.
UNH crashed 10.2% on 3.4x volume, bottom 1% of its year.
AMZN and AMD drew $9.6B and $9.5B inflows, up 3.8% and 5.3%.
Energy and health care sectors saw $3.3B and $3.2B outflows.

where_money_moved.evidence: AMZN and AMD combined for $19B inflow, 22.4% of the session's dollar-weighted move.
NVDA alone accounted for 24.7% of the session's dollar-weighted move with $17.9B outflow.
XLE and XLV saw $3.3B and $3.2B outflows, both at bottom 3% of their year.

who_is_driving.name: NVDA
who_is_driving.why: Drove 24.7% of the session's dollar-weighted move with $17.9B outflow on 1.6x volume, 5-day outflow streak.

who_is_driving.name: AMD
who_is_driving.why: 15.5% of the session's dollar-weighted move with $9.5B inflow, up 5.3% at the 87th percentile of its year.

who_is_driving.name: UNH
who_is_driving.why: 10.1% of the session's dollar-weighted move with $5.1B outflow on 3.4x volume, bottom 1% of its year.

key_tech.signal: Money rotated out of NVDA ($17.9B outflow) into AMD ($9.5B inflow), splitting the theme.
HACK surged 6.1% on 3.3x volume with $143M inflow, 100% breadth up.
MSTR fell 6.4% with $1.4B outflow, 5-day streak, while BTC rose 1.3% with $10.7B inflow.
Copper miners (COPX) dropped 6.3% on 3.1x volume, breadth 0% up.

stocks.note: Crashed 10.2% on 3.4x volume, bottom 1% of its year, $5.1B outflow.
Up 3.8% with $9.6B inflow, 97th percentile move, 2-day inflow streak.
Down 4.0% with $2.9B outflow, bottom 2% of its year, 1.3x volume.

risks: NVDA's 5-day outflow streak ($59.7B cumulative) could deepen if semis rotation continues.
UNH's 10% drop on 3.4x volume may signal broader health care sector weakness.
watch_tomorrow: Whether AMD's $9.5B inflow sustains or reverses after a 5.3% surge.
If TLT's +0.8% and yield drop (-3.7bps) attract more bond buying.
